cim: Enhancing pipeline integrity management with artificial intelligence and integrated technologies
cim_eredeti: Enhancing pipeline integrity management with artificial intelligence and integrated technologies
szoveg_eredeti:
The digital pipeline management platform introduced in the paper leverages AI, machine learning, and advanced technologies like fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) and drag reducing agents (DRA) to revolutionize pipeline integrity and operations. It creates a digital twin by integrating real-time data from SCADA systems, DAS, and pipeline inspection gauges (PIGs) to provide a dynamic, data-calibrated virtual representation of the physical pipeline.
